description:
Initialization: Assign tasks (descending reward, then task ID) to candidate satellite with lowest assigned duration; 
tie-break by smaller ID. Unassigned if no candidates.

Reassignment (test unobserved task-satellite pairs from base schedule):
- Pair Sorting: Sort candidate pairs by descending (reward - penalty), then ascending task and satellite ID (penalties start at 0).
- Penalty Update: Increment pair penalty if trial is infeasible or task fails to be scheduled on target.
- Acceptance: Select feasible trial with highest total reward strictly above current schedule; retain first on tie.
- Termination: Stop when no candidate improves or timeout expires (retain best verified checkpoint).
